info.name: accounting-system
info.description: Backend API for a multi-tenant, dual-currency ERP platform for Lebanese trading companies. See docs/API-DESIGN.md for envelope, pagination, and money-field conventions.

item.name: Accounting / GL
item.description: Journal entries and ledger reports (FR-901/FR-906). Draft → post → reverse; posted entries are immutable. Base amounts are computed server-side; every entry must balance (Σ debit_base = Σ credit_base). Set {{debitAccountId}} and {{creditAccountId}} to two non-control, active accounts (e.g. via GET /accounts) before creating an entry.

request.description: Requires journal.create (Company Admin). Creates a DRAFT entry (no number yet). At least two lines; each is a debit OR credit with amountOriginal/currency and optional rate (defaults to the exchange rate in force on the date, or 1 for the base currency). Rejected 400 if unbalanced, if a line targets a control account, or an inactive/unknown account. Test script saves journalEntryId. A line may carry partnerId (sub-ledger key). A control account (AR 41 / AP 40) line REQUIRES partnerId; other lines may omit it. Set debitAccountId to a control account and partnerId to a partner to post to the sub-ledger.

request.description: Requires journal.read. Every account’s net balance in debit/credit columns; totals must be equal. Optional asOf and branchId. numberPrefix (repeat/comma-separate) scopes the report to PCL sub-trees (e.g. 6,7 for P&L). rollUp=true collapses to one summary line per group (per prefix, or per class when no prefix) — a scoped/rolled section need not balance. A platform admin must pass companyId.

response.name: 200 OK (rolled up by class)

request.description: Requires account.create (Company Admin). Company-scoped caller is forced into their own company; a platform admin targets one via body companyId. type ∈ ASSET|LIABILITY|EQUITY|REVENUE|EXPENSE; normalBalance ∈ DEBIT|CREDIT; accountClass 1–7. Set parentId to nest, currencyRestriction (USD/LBP) to restrict, isControl+controlType (AR/AP/VAT_OUT/VAT_IN/CASH/BANK) for a control account. The test script saves accountId.

request.description: Append-only audit trail (FR-1102). Requires audit.read (Company Admin). Filter by entity, entityId, userId, action, and date range. A company caller only sees their active company; a platform admin sees across tenants and can narrow with companyId. Every mutating request is auto-logged by the AuditInterceptor (action from the HTTP verb, entity from the route, after-state from the result); financial domain events (POST/REVERSE) are logged by services with true before/after. Login is recorded as an explicit LOGIN event with the client IP.
